title: Make code_search path_glob match project-relative globs
why: matchesGlob ran an anchored regex over the absolute path, so 'src/**/*.ts' (the schema's own example), 'src/tools/*.ts' and '*.ts' matched nothing; the endsWith fallback over-matched
impact: Scoped code_search works as documented; no false 'No matches' or suffix over-matches
note: Hand-rolled matcher fixed instead of adding picomatch to keep zero new deps

title: Stop code_edit from rewriting the wrong span
why: Exported declarations spliced from 'function' (export export ...), ambiguous bare names edited the first match, and multi-declarator const edits deleted sibling declarators
impact: code_edit refuses ambiguous names and shared-statement edits and handles repeated export modifiers
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Validate code_read context_lines
why: A string context_lines caused string concatenation, negative values cut the symbol off, NaN returned nothing
impact: context_lines is coerced and clamped to 0..200
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Report failed code_edit calls as tool errors
why: 'symbol not found' and 'unsupported language' returned isError:false and were metered as savings
impact: Clients see failed edits as errors; failed edits no longer inflate savings
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Isolate codex-compat test servers from the real ~/.mozcode
why: Each test run wrote session pointers and metering rows into the developer's real store
impact: Running npm test no longer inflates the real dashboard and status line
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Flag code_search results cut off at the 200-match cap
why: The header said '200 matches' with no truncation flag
impact: The model knows a capped result is partial and is told to narrow the query
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Re-inject the SessionStart nudge after /clear and compaction
why: Matcher was 'startup|resume', so the code_* nudge was lost after /clear or auto-compaction
impact: Long sessions keep routing to the token-saving tools
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Keep a missing browser opener from crashing the MCP server
why: spawn() of a missing xdg-open/open emits an unhandled 'error' event; Windows used shell:true with an unquoted path
impact: moz_dashboard cannot crash the server; Windows paths with spaces open
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Skip metering lines that are not valid entries
why: A 'null' or '{}' line made summarize throw or spread NaN, so the status line showed $0.00
impact: Corrupt ledger lines are skipped instead of breaking every total
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Fix '1m 60s' in fmtDuration
why: Rounding after the remainder printed '1m 60s' / '1h 60m'
impact: Durations display correctly on the dashboard and status line
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: State the real token-count method on the dashboard and README
why: Dashboard and README claimed ~4 chars/token, but counts use the o200k BPE; README said build runs tsc
impact: The auditable-assumptions disclosure matches the code
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Make the bundle build atomic and cwd-independent
why: bundle.mjs deleted dist/ before esbuild ran and resolved paths from process.cwd()
impact: A failed or misplaced build can no longer delete the shipped bundle
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Don't cache rejected parser and analysis promises
why: A single transient wasm/parse failure was cached forever, disabling AST features until restart
impact: AST tools recover on the next call after a transient failure
note: logged after the fact; commit made earlier in this pass

title: Give Codex its own SessionStart hook
why: Codex loaded the Claude Code hooks/hooks.json, which rewrote ~/.claude/settings.json to point Claude Code's status line at the Codex plugin copy and nudged toward Read/Grep tools Codex lacks
impact: Codex sessions get a correct nudge (incl. after clear/compact) and never touch Claude Code settings
note: Scout suggestion; Codex hooks key and input fields verified against learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks

title: Keep a symlinked settings.json a symlink when installing the status line
why: Temp-file + rename replaced a dotfile-managed symlinked ~/.claude/settings.json with a regular file and reset its mode; temp file leaked on rename failure
impact: Dotfile-managed settings stay linked and keep their permissions

title: Stop benchmark:tokens writing into the real metering store
why: benchmark.ts recorded every call into ~/.mozcode unless MOZCODE_HOME was set, adding synthetic bench:corpus rows to the real ledger
impact: Benchmarks no longer inflate the user's real dashboard and status line
note: Verified: a full run left ~/.mozcode/metering/bench_corpus-*.jsonl at 498 lines. That file already holds 498 synthetic rows from an earlier run; the user may want to delete it

title: Invalidate the SQLite schema cache when the WAL file changes
why: The cache was keyed on the main file's mtime/size only; schema changes in an uncheckpointed -wal file were missed until refresh:true
impact: db_schema reflects new tables/columns in WAL-mode databases immediately

title: Parse Postgres index columns from indexdef correctly
why: indexColumns regex-cut indexdef at the first ')', so expression indexes, opclasses, DESC/NULLS, COLLATE and quoted names produced wrong or garbage column lists
impact: db_schema shows correct Postgres index columns; first unit tests on the Postgres path

title: Count only calls that saved tokens as avoided round-trips
why: Every code_edit/code_search/db_schema call counted as an avoided round-trip, including failed edits already in ledgers and no-match searches, inflating callsSaved, costSaved and timeSavedSec
impact: Dashboard and status line no longer credit failed or empty calls

title: Keep generic defaults in type-alias signatures
why: The type-alias signature was cut at the first '=', so 'type Box<T = string>' showed as 'type Box<T'
impact: code_outline shows full type parameters

title: Qualify nested Python class members with the full class path
why: Nested class members were qualified only by the inner class name, so 'Meta.run' matched Outer.Meta.run before a top-level Meta.run, and code_read/code_edit hit the wrong symbol
impact: Qualified lookups in files with nested classes resolve to the intended symbol

title: Keep the status line's session segment when the cwd changes
why: Session entries were matched by exact equality with stdin cwd, which follows the session into subdirectories while the server meters under the launch dir, so the session segment fell to $0.00
impact: Status line keeps showing current-session savings after cd into a subdirectory

title: Make verify-bundle runnable and cover the status line bundle
why: verify-bundle.mjs had no npm script, was cwd-dependent, leaked temp dirs and the child on failure, and never checked dist/statusline.js
impact: npm run verify:bundle proves both shipped bundles run without node_modules

title: Add CI that runs typecheck, tests and a stale-bundle check
why: No .github/ existed; the committed dist/ the tests exercise could be stale relative to src/ with nothing catching it
impact: Every push/PR typechecks, fails on a stale bundle, runs tests and verify:bundle on Node 22 and 24
note: Scout suggestion; npm audit/OSV left out so CI does not start red on existing advisories. Not run on GitHub (never push); local build verified byte-identical to committed dist/

title: Resolve the hook's plugin root with fileURLToPath
why: The fallback used URL.pathname (percent-encoded, /C:/ on Windows), so a plugin path with a space silently skipped the status line install
impact: The fallback works for paths with spaces and on Windows

title: Make the benchmark scripts fail loudly and stop hard-coding counts
why: A missing zod corpus was skipped silently (NaN% if empty); '69 -> 4' was a literal printed as 'Measured'; reduce() without an initial value threw an opaque TypeError
impact: Benchmark output is honest about what is measured and fails clearly on a missing corpus
note: Noticed while running: benchmark:performance reports cached db_schema at 0.22x vs raw SQLite (slower); not investigated in this pass

title: Warn when code_edit leaves the edited symbol undefined
why: Nothing checked that new_source still defined the requested symbol (and the parse guard is skipped on files with errors), yet the reply said 'No re-read needed'
impact: The model is told when an edit removed or renamed the symbol instead of assuming success
note: Warning, not rejection, to keep intentional renames/deletions working

title: Pin code_edit splicing after non-ASCII text
why: Hot-spot lead said spans were UTF-8 byte offsets; verified false on web-tree-sitter 0.25 (UTF-16 code units), but nothing guarded it
impact: A future web-tree-sitter upgrade that changes offset semantics fails the suite instead of corrupting files
note: The high-severity UTF-8 lead was not reproducible; this commit only adds the guard

title: Remove the unused readFileSafe helper
why: Dead code whose name implied a non-throwing read but which was a bare fs.readFile
impact: Less misleading surface in src/util

title: Mark the original design spec as historical
why: Spec read 'approved, executing' while describing a PostToolUse hook, .scm queries and ripgrep that don't exist and omitting db_schema, statusline, Codex
impact: Readers are pointed to README/src and told exactly where the spec diverges

title: Ignore the dashboard preview output
why: preview-dashboard.ts writes dash-preview.html to the repo root, which was not gitignored
impact: Previewing the dashboard can no longer leak a generated file into commits

title: Atomic code_edit write (temp + rename)
why: fs.writeFile truncates in place
note: Low confidence the trade-off is right: rename breaks symlinks/hard links and file modes, which needs the same handling as the settings fix; the crash window is small

title: Signed savings (book overhead instead of clamping to 0)
why: makeMeta clamps savedTokens at 0
note: Product/metric-definition change that alters every headline number; needs an owner decision

title: moz_status doctor self-test
why: moz_status prints static text only
note: New feature, not a correctness fix

title: Tighten statusline isOurs() heuristic
why: Substring match on 'mozcode' + 'statusline.js'
note: Low impact; any stricter rule risks orphaning existing installs

title: engines field / Node version declaration
why: node:sqlite needs Node 22.12+ while the bundle targets node18
note: Runtime falls back to the sqlite3 CLI; the right floor (18 for runtime, 22.12 for dev/tests) is a maintainer call

title: Per-tool sparklines, TOOL_ORDER colour fallback, byFile cross-project merge, UTC byDay
why: Dashboard cosmetics
note: Cosmetic/low impact

title: Atomic session pointer, install-codex atomic re-register, codex-compat harness hardening, test temp cleanup
why: Low-severity robustness
note: Low impact; stopped here

title: Run code_search queries on a linear-time regex engine (re2js)
why: Model-supplied regex ran on V8's backtracking engine synchronously on the stdio event loop; (a+)+$ froze the server (ReDoS)
impact: No query can stall the MCP server; ordinary regex syntax still works, lookaround/backreference queries fall back to a literal search with a note
note: Scout suggestion (re2js 2.8.6, MIT, no deps). dist/server.js grows by ~6.3k lines of bundled RE2 tables; verify:bundle passes

title: Only let db_schema read env vars that hold a Postgres URL
why: connection_env is model-chosen; a prompt-injected call could point pg at any secret in the server env and get error text back
impact: Non-Postgres-URL values are refused before pg parses or dials them, and the error never echoes the value
note: URL-shape check instead of a fixed allow-list so existing custom variable names keep working

title: Bound db_schema introspection on the server side
why: query_timeout only stops the client waiting; the catalog query kept running server-side, and the sqlite3 CLI fallback had no timeout
impact: Postgres introspection runs in BEGIN READ ONLY with statement_timeout/lock_timeout; sqlite3 CLI is killed after 10 s
note: SET LOCAL rather than startup options so PgBouncer transaction mode works. Verified against a disposable local Postgres 18; opt-in test via MOZCODE_TEST_POSTGRES_URL

title: Create the metering store and dashboard private to the user
why: Ledger, session pointers and dashboard.html list project paths and file names but were created 0755/0644
impact: Other local users can no longer read a user's project paths and file names from new MOZCODE state
note: Creation modes only; existing ~/.mozcode files keep their mode (users can chmod -R go-rwx ~/.mozcode). The swallowed-errors / per-call mkdir parts of the lead are quality/perf, left for those passes

title: Escape timestamp-derived day labels in the dashboard
why: p.day (from the ledger ts) was the only ledger-derived string interpolated raw into the dashboard SVG
impact: A tampered ledger line cannot inject markup into dashboard.html; escaping of paths/tools/sessions/timestamps is now pinned by a test
note: Test fails on the old renderer. localStorage try/catch in the theme toggle is a reliability issue, not security; left for the quality pass

title: Keep code_edit writes inside the project root
why: code_edit accepted absolute and ../ paths (also while UNRESOLVED), so a prompt-injected model could rewrite code in other repos, plugin hooks or global packages, bypassing the host's workspace write boundary
impact: Writes outside the project (../, absolute, sibling-prefix, symlink escapes) are refused unless MOZCODE_ALLOW_EDIT_OUTSIDE_PROJECT=1
note: Read tools (code_read/code_outline/db_schema path) left unconfined on purpose, matching host Read tools; confining them is a product call (see skipped entry)

title: Update the MCP SDK and patched transitive deps, rebuild dist
why: npm audit: high in @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0, fast-uri (inlined in dist/server.js), ip-address, nanoid, source-map-js; critical proxy-addr; moderate qs, hono
impact: npm audit --omit=dev reports 0 vulnerabilities; the shipped bundle carries the patched SDK 1.32.1 and fast-uri 3.1.8
note: Scout suggestion. Remaining: vitest chain (dev-only) needs a semver-major bump, attempted separately

title: Upgrade vitest to 5 to clear critical dev-dependency advisories
why: Critical advisories in vitest 3.2.7, tinypool and @vitest/mocker remained after the runtime fixes
impact: npm audit reports 0 vulnerabilities across all deps
note: Semver-major, dev-only; vitest 5 needs Node ^22.12/24+, matching what the suite and CI already require. dist/ unchanged

title: Confine code_read / code_outline / db_schema path to the project
why: Read tools accept absolute and ../ paths
note: Product decision: host Read tools also read outside the workspace and monorepo users read sibling packages. Question for the owner: should reads be confined too (same opt-out as code_edit)?

title: Shell-quote pluginRoot in the status line command
why: hooks/statusline-install.mjs interpolates pluginRoot inside double quotes
note: Low confidence it is worth it: the source is the host's CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT or the hook's own path (trusted), changing the quoting would rewrite every existing install's settings.json, and Windows quoting differs

title: V8 linear-time regexp flag for code_search
why: Alternative ReDoS fix
note: Superseded by the re2js commit; the flag needs launch-arg changes in two manifests and does not cover the i/u flags

title: Plugin userConfig (sensitive) for the Postgres URL
why: Keep the DB secret out of the user's shell env
note: New configuration feature rather than a fix; the URL-shape guard already closes the arbitrary-env-var read. Owner decision

title: Reuse one parser per language and free parse trees
why: parserFor created a new WASM Parser on every call and extractSymbols never deleted the Tree; the WASM heap is not garbage collected and never shrinks, so every cache miss and code_edit validation leaked memory in the long-lived MCP server
impact: 1500 parses of src/db/schema.ts: RSS 129 MB -> 1067 MB before, 127 MB -> 197 MB after (flat at 4000 parses); 4.9 ms/parse unchanged (.repochad/bench/parse-rss.ts)
note: Regression test fails before the fix (235 MB growth over 400 parses) and passes after (~1-10 MB)

title: Cap each tree-sitter parse at 500 ms
why: extractSymbols parsed synchronously with no limit, so one huge or minified file blocked the single-threaded stdio server for every other call
impact: 6.1 MB TS file: event-loop block 1465 ms -> 517 ms; 4.3 MB dist/server.js 899 ms -> 519 ms; bounded at ~500 ms for any size; normal parses unchanged at 4.9 ms (.repochad/bench/parse-budget.ts)
note: Cancelled parse calls parser.reset() because the parser is now shared; a test covers parsing a new file right after a cancel

title: Cap code_read's plain-text fallback at 2000 lines / 100k chars
why: For unsupported or too-large-to-parse files, code_read returned the whole file numbered with no cap, costing more tokens than the built-in Read
impact: package-lock.json: 45,592 returned tokens -> 29,744 (file is 39,422 tokens); a multi-MB log or bundle is now bounded at ~100k chars instead of growing with file size (.repochad/bench/plain-read.mts)
note: Truncation marker tells the model to use the built-in Read with an offset for the rest

title: Count a file's baseline tokens once per version
why: read/outline/edit re-ran synchronous o200k BPE over the whole source on every call just for the metering baseline, dominating warm-cache latency and blocking the event loop on large files
impact: Warm-cache, 200 calls: schema.ts code_read 3.1 -> 1.3 ms, code_outline 1.9 -> 0.3 ms; 300 KB TS file code_read 24.4 -> 1.0 ms, code_outline 27.9 -> 4.3 ms (.repochad/bench/read-hot.mts)
note: Memoized in a WeakMap keyed by the cached analysis object, so it is invalidated with the file version

title: Read the metering ledger once per moz_savings call
why: moz_savings called loadEntries() twice, reading and parsing the entire all-project ledger twice per call
impact: Ledger I/O and JSON parsing per moz_savings call halved (2 full reads -> 1)
note: Covered by existing integration tests of moz_savings

title: Read code_search files in parallel batches of 32
why: code_search awaited up to 5000 stats/reads one at a time, so cold-cache latency was per-file I/O latency times the file count
impact: Synthetic 3000-file tree, no-match query: cold 278 -> 123 ms, warm 84 -> 55 ms (.repochad/bench/search-cold.mts)
note: Scan order and the 200-match cap stay deterministic; new test covers >2 batches with truncation

title: Say when code_search hits the 5000-file limit
why: listSourceFiles stopped silently at 5000 files and path_glob was applied after the cap, so large repos got silent false 'No matches' and narrow globs could be starved
impact: Truncation is now reported; path_glob-scoped searches count only matching files toward the cap; walk order deterministic across filesystems; no latency change (3000-file bench cold 117 ms, warm 58 ms)
note: .gitignore support (node-ignore) not added: new runtime dependency, left for the owner

title: Group Postgres catalog rows in linear time
why: postgresSnapshot copied each table's array on every row (O(k^2) per table) and duplicated the existing groupRows helper
impact: Mocked catalog with one 30,000-column table: first db_schema call 1175 ms -> 116 ms; O(k^2) -> O(k) per table (.repochad/bench/pg-grouping.md)
note: New test covers the Postgres snapshot path with a mocked pg Client

title: Cap db_schema output at a 50k-character budget
why: renderSnapshot had no output cap, so schemas with thousands of tables returned everything in one tool result
impact: 1500-table SQLite schema: 83,020 -> 16,461 returned tokens (313,953 -> 58,134 chars); omitted objects are named and query narrows the result (.repochad/bench/schema-cap.mts)
note: Schemas under the budget render unchanged

title: Keep an incremental ledger rollup for the status line
why: Every status line refresh (a fresh process per prompt update) re-read and parsed the entire never-rotated all-project ledger, so cost grew with lifetime usage
impact: 200k-entry (37 MB) ledger: 0.24 s -> 0.04-0.05 s per refresh (flat, same as empty ledger); O(lifetime entries) -> O(new entries) (.repochad/bench/statusline-ledger.md)
note: Rollup in ~/.mozcode/cache; recounts on truncation/replacement/misaligned offset. An in-place rewrite that keeps a newline at the old offset is not detected (the ledger is append-only by design). moz_savings and the dashboard still read the full ledger on demand

title: Make metering writes non-blocking
why: server.ts awaits mkdir+append before each tool response
note: Low impact (sub-millisecond local append) and making it fire-and-forget would let moz_savings miss the call it just made; not worth the ordering risk

title: Fix file-cache byte accounting (UTF-16, symbols, trees)
why: 64 MiB budget counts only stat.size
note: Low confidence it matters: trees are now freed after parse, and an oversized entry is evicted on the next access to another file; a precise memory model is guesswork

title: Postgres introspection via pg_index and fewer round trips
why: 4 sequential catalog queries and an information_schema PK subquery
note: Cannot verify against a real PostgreSQL here (opt-in test is skipped); one pg Client cannot pipeline queries anyway

title: Move SQLite introspection off the event loop
why: DatabaseSync is synchronous
note: Catalog queries are small and already bounded; the CLI fallback already has a 10 s timeout from the security pass

title: Loosen the statusline exit-delay timing assertion
why: exitMs - firstByteMs < 150 could flake on loaded CI
note: Test-stability tweak, not a scale fix; no flake observed in this run

title: Outline depth control and directory outlines
why: Serena-style depth/budget for code_outline
note: Changes default output (hides members) and adds a feature; product decision for the owner

title: .gitignore-aware source walk (node-ignore)
why: Fixed IGNORED_DIRS list ignores .gitignore
note: Adds a runtime dependency; the file-limit truncation is now reported instead, owner can decide on the dependency

title: Switch grammars to @vscode/tree-sitter-wasm and web-tree-sitter 0.27
why: Unblocks newer web-tree-sitter with FinalizationRegistry
note: Medium-effort dependency migration with possible node-type differences; explicit tree/parser freeing already fixes the leak
